test(ui): migrate remaining Details controls coverage

Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR exposes Create PR in desktop Details and moves eligible publisher choices into the branch’s ellipsis menu. **Example:** A desktop session has an unpublished branch and publishers @system-bot and @alice-tools. - **Before:** Publishing requires opening the branch menu, and selecting @alice-tools requires another nested menu. - **After:** Create PR appears beside the branch, and @alice-tools can be selected directly from the ellipsis menu. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Clear visual proof and focused owner reuse support the change; the remaining defect is outdated user navigation documentation. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected before/after screenshots exercise the actual desktop Details renderer with a mock Gateway and synthetic publishers, directly showing inline Create PR and flattened account choices; the supplied integration coverage supports identity, consent, and recovery behavior without claiming a real GitHub publication. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Preference · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Desktop users must navigate nested menus to find PR creation and choose a publisher. **Reason:** The maintainer author also contributed the current Details presentation, establishing direction for this focused usability improvement. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep this PR open: the maintainer-authored presentation improvement is useful, preserves the existing publication owner, and needs one low-priority documentation correction. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5` ## Before merge - [ ] **Update the documented desktop publisher controls (P3)** - With both publishers available, this change removes the desktop account arrow and places its choices directly in the ellipsis menu, but docs/web/control-ui/chat.md:591 still tells users to use the arrow beside Publish PR and describes recovery actions as inline. Users following https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat will look for controls that no longer exist in that desktop layout. Update that paragraph for Create PR, the publisher menu, and Review while retaining the mobile distinction; root AGENTS.md requires documentation to follow behavior changes. ## Findings - [P3] Update the documented desktop publisher controls — `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests-content.tsx:433-434`
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI renders session branch and publication information from the existing GitHub publication owner; user actions invoke its scoped selection, publication, confirmation, and recovery callbacks. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Session Details] --> B[Branch row] B --> C[Create PR action] B --> D[Publisher and review menu] C --> E[Publication owner] D --> E E --> F[Gateway publication broker] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the shared publication controls and update the chat guide to describe the new desktop navigation. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main markup and the inspected before screenshots establish the nested-menu behavior; no target code or tests were executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The implementation reuses the existing eligibility projection, account-menu rendering, publication callbacks, and native menu owner; its added branching handles the distinct inline, personal-consent, and recovery presentations without creating another state owner. Full review comments: - [P3] Update the documented desktop publisher controls — `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests-content.tsx:433-434` With both publishers available, this change removes the desktop account arrow and places its choices directly in the ellipsis menu, but docs/web/control-ui/chat.md:591 still tells users to use the arrow beside Publish PR and describes recovery actions as inline. Users following https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat will look for controls that no longer exist in that desktop layout. Update that paragraph for Create PR, the publisher menu, and Review while retaining the mobile distinction; root AGENTS.md requires documentation to follow behavior changes. Confidence: 0.98 Overall correctness: patch is correct Overall confidence: 0.94 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [e8d8145cd62f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8d8145cd62feac71d6c65636c948a74b7f799d6). ### Provenance checked - `Desktop branch actions and publication placement` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (33b16c7ef875e94b387f61a78fdb4942333e45ac: Compact Details grouped publication and review controls in an actions menu while retaining mounted content and keyboard access.) - `Eligible publisher choices and explicit personal consent` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160967: Hide redundant account controls while retaining explicit personal selection, exact account binding, and recovery; the Solid and mobile implementations carried that contract forward.) - `Native menu lifecycle and retained content` keeps the original intent (84617eabd35800aa329663bc1e5ae2ea8de8b8fd: Replace legacy menus with the shared native primitives while preserving dismissal, focus, and retained-panel behavior.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - git diff --check - pnpm format:docs:check - pnpm docs:check-mdx - pnpm docs:check-links What I checked: - **Pinned change and current-main behavior:** The introduced diff exposes the primary action and flattens publisher choices; current main retains the original nested presentation in these production modules. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests-content.tsx:433`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests-content.tsx#L433), [2c6220752be6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5)) - **Existing publication authority remains authoritative:** The extracted eligibility projection preserves its existing conditions, and the renderer continues invoking the publication owner’s callbacks rather than constructing publication requests or selecting replacement credentials. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-github-publication.tsx:36`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-github-publication.tsx#L36), [2c6220752be6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5)) - **Direct visual evidence:** Inspected all four prepared images: the actual Control UI with synthetic accounts and a mock Gateway shows the previous nested controls and the new inline Create PR action with publisher choices in one menu. ([2c6220752be6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5)) - **Documented navigation becomes inaccurate:** The published chat guide still describes an account arrow beside Publish PR and inline recovery actions; desktop now uses Create PR, the ellipsis menu, and Review. See https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat. ([`docs/web/control-ui/chat.md:591`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat), [2c6220752be6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c6220752be68495e8ef3c317a347545c50625d5)) - **Feature direction and prior intent:** The same feature contributor authored the compact Details layout in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176424; the current PR deliberately changes its discoverability while retaining the explicit personal-consent contract documented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160967. ([`ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests-content.tsx:258`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/33b16c7ef875e94b387f61a78fdb4942333e45ac/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-pull-requests-content.tsx#L258), [33b16c7ef875](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33b16c7ef875e94b387f61a78fdb4942333e45ac)) - **Exact-head CI:** The reviewed head has successful openclaw/ci-gate, dependency-review, and security-sensitive-review statuses; the cancelled dispatch is not evidence of a patch-caused failure.
